feeds.title: John McDonald
feeds.description: Find art critic articles, film reviews, articles from Sydney morning Herald and more! For over thirty years John has been one of Australia's best-known critics. He writes a weekly art column for the Sydney Morning Herald, a weekly film column for the Australian Financial Review, and contributes to a wide range of local and international publications.
